foreign.example: Domani hai l'esame? In bocca al lupo!

foreign.meaning: to get your act together, to step it up
foreign.example: Si quieres terminar hoy, ponte las pilas.
foreign.example_en: If you want to finish today, step it up.

foreign.meaning: to not be bothered, too lazy to do it
foreign.example: J'ai la flemme de cuisiner ce soir.
foreign.example_en: I can't be bothered to cook tonight.

foreign.meaning: to be daydreaming, not paying attention

hebrew.meaning: amazing — or a total waste of time. Only the tone tells you which.
hebrew.example: ההופעה אתמול הייתה חבל על הזמן!
שברתי את הראש על הבאג הזה כל הבוקר.
hebrew.example_en: I racked my brain over this bug all morning.
